reason: I don't put my card into some unknown website for an app that isn't even in the App Store. The money isn't the issue, it's not knowing who is behind it and where my card details end up.
objection: Paying by card on a site I've never heard of, for something installed from the browser instead of the App Store or Google Play. And honestly, I'm not sure my kids won't see straight through it.
would_change_my_mind: If it were sold through the App Store or Google Play, or a friend in one of my WhatsApp groups showed me a trick that really fooled everyone.
